title: PlanStatus
description:
Where the plan of one launched session stands, as the server derives it (ADR 0071). The
companion keeps the newest per launch and answers `plan_status` from it.

approval.description:
The newest counted approval and whether it is of the current version; an approval whose
version is not `current` does not cover the plan as it is.

branch.description: The plan on the issue branch, when there is one.

draft.description: The newest settled revision of the launch's draft (ADR 0053).

review.description: The issue's newest counted design review.

ApprovalRecord.description:
A person's approval of a plan (ADR 0054): an issue comment whose first line is
`Approved: plan <sha>` or `Approved: plan <sha> on <branch>` (ADR 0027), from a trusted
author only; or an approval given in Rubato, with its `approval_id` and no comment.

approval_id.description: The `rubato_approvals` row, for an approval given in Rubato.

branch.description: The branch the approval names; else the branch Rubato reads the plan from.

bundle_hash.description: The bundle an approval given in Rubato covers (the plan, its design note, its ADRs).

comment_id.description: The comment's id, for a comment approval.

sha.description:
The plan hash approved (checkboxes cleared, git blob sha). Absent when the comment names
none: the approval then shows as "version not named".

source.description: Absent for a comment, which is all an approval was before ADR 0054.

url.description: The comment's URL; empty for an approval given in Rubato.

oneOf.description:
An `Approved:` comment on the issue (ADR 0027). Counted only when posted before the
cutover, `RUBATO_COMMENT_APPROVALS_UNTIL`.
An approval given in Rubato, recorded in `rubato_approvals`.

ApprovalState.description: The newest counted approval of an issue's plan, and whether it is of the current version.

current_sha.description: The hash of the plan compared with, when there is one.

ApprovalVersion.description: How an approval relates to the plan Rubato holds now.

oneOf.description: The approved hash is the plan's hash now.
The plan changed after the approval (finding `ApprovalStale`).
No plan file to compare with on that branch.

The approval names the plan as it is now, but the plan does not fit the map, so the
approval does not count (ADR 0029, finding `ApprovedWithoutFit`).

carries_approval.description: Whether the plan on the branch carries the approval record (ADR 0054).

sha.description: The plan's hash at the branch head.

fits.description: Whether the revision's plan fits the map.

plan_sha.description: The revision's plan hash, as an approval names it.

ReviewRecord.description:
A design review posted as an issue comment, first line `Review: <track> — <outcome>`
(ADR 0027). Only a trusted author's review is kept.

outcome.description: The rest of the first line, e.g. `passed after fixes`.

plan_sha.description: The plan version the review read, when its `Plan` section names one.
